name: Quickened Arcane Catalyst
body:
Aura Strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs; Price 64,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

This rod allows the wielder to pay 4 points from one ability score of her choice to cast an arcane spell as though it were modified by the Quicken Spell metamagic feat. If the wielder is has the pact class feature she may use this item’s effects on her invocation and mystic blast class features as though with the Quicken Spell metamagic feat and he may use this item once per day without paying its cost. This rod can affect up to 16 total levels of spells or spell-like abilities in a single day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Quicken Spell; Cost 32,000 gp
